comps.label: C1
comps.reason: Trades, leases and repairs used aircraft and engines for airlines; Crane makes valves, pumps and components rather than trading aircraft.

comps.label: C2
comps.reason: Makes instruments, motors and power devices; overlaps only on aerospace sensors, not on Crane's valves, pumps or composites.

comps.label: C3
comps.reason: Builds asphalt plants, crushers and drills for road and mining customers; no overlap with Crane's valves, pumps or aerospace.

comps.label: C4
comps.reason: Makes roof coatings, sealants and HVAC parts for construction; shares valves but serves building contractors, not aerospace or process plants.

comps.label: C5
comps.reason: Distributes MRO supplies and test equipment and runs outsourced inventory; a distributor rather than a valve, pump or aerospace manufacturer.

comps.label: C6
comps.reason: Makes welding and cutting consumables and equipment for fabricators; a different product and customer base from Crane.

comps.label: C7
comps.reason: Makes aerospace valves and fluid control components alongside filtration and aerospace defense products, overlapping Crane's aerospace and fluid lines; utility metering differs.

comps.label: C8
comps.reason: Makes pumps, valves and seals sold to process plants with aftermarket repair, closely matching Crane's industrial flow products and service model.

comps.label: C9
comps.reason: Makes steel and plastic industrial containers and paperboard packaging, plus timberland; no valve, pump or aerospace overlap.

comps.label: C10
comps.reason: Makes pumps, valves and aerospace connectors and sensors with aftermarket repair for industrial and aerospace customers, matching Crane's mix.

comps.label: C11
comps.reason: Mainly papermaking and wood processing machinery; fluid handling and composites are minor lines serving mills, not Crane's customers.

comps.label: C12
comps.reason: Makes emissions-certified engines and generator sets for equipment makers; no valve, pump or aerospace overlap.

comps.label: C13
comps.reason: Develops paints, coatings and sealants; chemical materials business, not valves, pumps or aerospace components.

comps.label: C14
comps.reason: Builds business jets, helicopters and military vehicles with aircraft maintenance; Crane supplies components, not whole aircraft.

comps.label: C15
comps.reason: Makes locks, hinges, hardware and metal castings for equipment makers; no valves, pumps or aerospace overlap.

comps.label: C16
comps.reason: Makes centrifugal and positive displacement pumps sold through distributors to industrial, petroleum and defense buyers, overlapping Crane's pump line.

comps.label: C17
comps.reason: Makes heat tracing and process heating systems for plant operators; serves similar plants but offers no valves, pumps or aerospace products.
